# Ha-Shilth-Sa

> > Canada's oldest First Nations newspaper, serving Nuu-chah-nulth communities on Vancouver Island and the west coast with news, cultural coverage, and indigenous perspectives.

Ha-Shilth-Sa is a cornerstone publication for the Nuu-chah-nulth people and other First Nations communities across British Columbia and the Pacific Northwest. The newspaper covers indigenous affairs, environmental issues, community events, and aboriginal rights with a focus on west-coast perspectives.
